prediction.separate_gravity: d<K>/dE = -1.00 +- 0.05 after re-virialisation (virial theorem, Lynden-Bell 1999); with Plummer softening the virial value is K = E*w/(w-2), w = <W_soft>/<U_soft> (Mentat solve_equation), i.e. -w/(2-w), about -0.99 for eps = 0.02 b
prediction.same_gas: d<K>/dE >= 0 (+1 for an ideal gas at fixed volume; C_gas = (3/2) N k_B = 2.65e-21 J/K at N = 128)

prereg.protocol_as_designed: Plummer N = 128, M = 1e12 kg, b = 5 km, eps = 0.02 b, dt = t_cross/300 with t_cross := sqrt(b^3/(G M)) (the sketch's definition), velocity-Verlet NBodySystem.step; seeds 1, 2, 3 with the sketch's sampler; relax 10 t_cross (3000 steps); inject by scaling peculiar velocities by (1+delta), delta in {-0.10, -0.05, 0, +0.05, +0.10}, from the SAME relaxed state; integrate int(3 t_relax/dt) = 2374 steps with t_relax = 2.638 t_cross (Mentat); <K> over samples with k*dt > 2 t_relax (the sketch's window); dE = ((1+delta)^2 - 1) K0.
prereg.primary_statistic: raw slope per seed = np.polyfit(dE, <K>_delta - <K>_0, 1)[0] over delta in {-0.10, -0.05, +0.05, +0.10}, all particles, pre-registered window; then mean and sample std (ddof = 1) over the 3 seeds

pass_fail_fixed.SEPARATE: mean raw slope in [-1.10, -0.90] AND seed std <= 0.05 AND softened-energy drift <= 1e-4
pass_fail_fixed.UNRESOLVED: mean slope in (-0.90, 0), or in the band but a std/drift gate fails, or below -1.10 (negative but off the prediction); reported as such, never rounded into a pass
pass_fail_fixed.drift_metric: end-point |E_soft(end)/E_soft(start) - 1| of every integrated segment (relax and each branch), maximum over segments; the max-over-time excursion is reported alongside

prereg.gate_before_injection: over the last 5 t_cross of relax: 2<K>/|<W_soft>| in [0.97, 1.03] AND |<2K + W_soft> - (1/2)[Idot]/T| / |<W_soft>| <= 1e-3 (trapezoid time averages, samples every step)
secondary_analyses_declared_now: LJ-corrected slope: K_LJ = <K> - (1/4)[Idot]/T per window (equals -<W_soft>/2 by the Lagrange-Jacobi identity), slope as above
bound-only slope: <K_bound> (particles with e_i = v^2/2 + phi_soft,i < 0) vs the same dE

EXTENDED window, same thresholds: each branch is integrated on to 6 t_relax (int(6 t_relax/dt) = 4749 steps); <K> over k in [2374, 4749). Declared now because the design's t_cross = sqrt(b^3/GM) is 6.26x shorter than the Heggie-Mathieu crossing time (Mentat (3pi/32)^(-3/2)) and the design's post-injection run (7.9 units) is only 0.60 of the orbital period at the half-mass radius (Mentat orbital_period 13.24 units) -- the pre-registered window may sit inside the breathing oscillation. The extended window is the corrected-criterion analysis; the original stays the primary.
time-resolved slope: running mean of <K> over one design t_relax, slope from the four branches at each time (figure)
prereg.could_it_fail: Yes in the sense of the design's three outcomes: SAME would need the injected energy to stay kinetic (the t = 0+ slope is +1 by construction); UNRESOLVED if the cluster has not re-virialised inside the window or escapers/drift spoil it. But a slope of -1 is the virial theorem for any bound, stationary 1/r system: a pass validates that the engine integrates 1/r gravity and that the window is long enough, and adds no evidence beyond the theorem itself about whether gravity and gas thermodynamics are one phenomenon.

process_notes: Relax phase (3000 steps per seed) ran in u3_worker.py; it was then stopped and the five branches per seed were run by u3_branches.py in lockstep from the saved relaxed positions/velocities (rebuild checked bit-for-bit against the saved diagnostics). Same engine, dt, eps, deltas and diagnostics; the switch only changes the order of work so the pre-registered window finished for all branches at once and the extension could be stopped at equal length.

Extension planned to 6 design t_relax (4749 steps); stopped with a STOP file to keep the wall clock near the 90 min budget under a machine shared with other agents (0.20-0.25 s per step); the extended window actually used is choices.ext_last_step_available.
An earlier sequential start (killed after ~500 relax steps) was discarded; the runs reported here started fresh.

decomposition_posthoc.identity: <K> = -<E_s> + L + <U_s - W_s>, L = (1/2)[Idot]/T  (Lagrange-Jacobi, softened); so d<K>/dE = -1 + dL/dE + d<U_s-W_s>/dE
decomposition_posthoc.tag: [VERIFIED numerics] identity residual 0.0000 in every window; [BY CONSTRUCTION] the fully corrected slope <K> - L

design_corrections: Unit mismatch: the design's t_cross = sqrt(b^3/GM) = 43277 s is 6.256 x shorter than the Heggie-Mathieu crossing time GM^(5/2)/(2|E|)^(3/2) of a Plummer sphere (Mentat simplify_expr (3pi/32)^(-3/2)); t_relax/t_cross = 0.1N/lnN = 2.638 (Mentat) refers to the latter. So 'relax 10 t_cross' is 1.6 t_cr and '3 t_relax = 7.9 t_cross' is 1.27 t_cr = 0.48 standard t_relax, shorter than one orbital period at the half-mass radius (13.24 design units, Mentat orbital_period) and shorter in seconds than P5b's run (12 t_ff = 5.8e5 s vs 3.4e5 s).

Seed-std gate (<= 0.05) is not reachable with N = 128, delta <= 0.10 and a 2.6-unit window: the seed scatter is the Lagrange-Jacobi breathing term (std of dL/dE = 0.224 pre-registered window), a coherent, slowly damped oscillation of the cluster after the kick, not sampling noise of the virial value. A criterion on the time-averaged slope needs windows spanning several breathing periods (>~ 3 x 13 design units), or a criterion stated on the identity.

The design's 'LJ-corrected' K_LJ = <K> - (1/4)[Idot]/T equals -<W_s>/2 and removes only HALF of the non-stationarity term; removing all of it (<K> - L) returns -1 + d<U_s-W_s>/dE by construction (-0.989 +- 0.003), so neither correction is a test; the raw slope is the test.
Drift metric unspecified in the design: end-point softened-energy drift (pre-registered metric) is 2.8e-5 <= 1e-4 (pass); the max-over-time excursion is 2.1e-4 (would fail a strict reading).

The gate (2<K>/|<W_s>| over the last 5 units of relax) passes for all seeds (1.020, 1.016, 1.005) but does not guarantee a virialised injection instant: seed 1 was kicked at instantaneous 2K/|W_s| = 1.094; the delta = 0 control removes the common relaxation only to first order.
Gas side is still formula only (heat_capacity_equipartition(3, 128) = 2.6508e-21 J/K); the Tait-box repeat waits for S8.

engine_defects.defect: Mentat gateway power-tower guard (_HUGE regex) false-positive: any expression of the form (...x^2)^(p) is refused as 'looks like code'
engine_defects.evidence: integrate_expr {'expression': '3*x^2*(1+x^2)^(-5/2)', 'variable': 'x'} -> error 'That input looks like code, not maths'; the regex (\^|\*\*)\s*\(?\s*[\d.]+\s*\)?\s*(\^|\*\*) matches '^2)^'. integrate_expr 'x^2' works. Blocks the Plummer mass integral; not used as a pass/fail input.

engine_defects.defect: (already filed PHYSICS_GAP, not new) NBodySystem.total_energy() sums the unsoftened 1/r potential
engine_defects.evidence: this run used its own softened U_s and W_s; softened energy conserved to 2.8e-5 end-point
